text:
Anya: Heads up — CI shows a regression on mistral-gqa after yesterday's kernel swap. Median p95 up ~18% on MQA/GQA-heavy traces :warning:
Mike: Any flamegraphs or perf traces? could be the new kernel choosing a non-quantized codepath for certain head layouts
Sophia: I grabbed the allocator + kv logs. Notable: `evict_pages` rate jumps and page fragmentation metric spikes right after the swap. Example from node-7: `evict_pages: 2432 -> 3601` in 10m window. Suggest testing fallback kernel for seq<128 to confirm
Chen: Ran a quick local microbench (bench_srv) — baseline pre-swap p95=42ms, post-swap p95=50ms (batch=8, seq=512). Throughput down ~12%. I also toggled num_key_value_heads 32->16 and saw throughput drop ~6% but memory pressure reduced
Anya: That aligns with what I suspected — the new kernel's head packing assumes head_stride multiple of 64; our current mixtral/mistral configs use 48 in some variants. Misaligned vector loads could be thrashing the paged KV layout :eyes:
Mike: Can we try kernel hint + kv compaction flags? e.g. `export KERNEL_HINT=prefer_packed_heads` and `export KV_PAGE_COMPACT=1` then rerun the bench. Also capture `nvprof` and flame
infra-bot: CI job 6721 finished — perf-regression repros on canary infra. Tests: all green. Artifact: /ci/artifacts/6721/flame.svg
Sophia: Flame shows big hotspots in `kv_page_merge` and `memcpy` from small fragments. Paged layout causes many small copies when pages are coalesced. For MQA with seq>256 we need a slab coalescing pass on eviction
Chen: I prototyped a coalesce-on-evict patch (local). bench results: p95 down 50ms->44ms, p99 92ms->81ms. Patch is light — toggled via `coalesce_pages_on_evict = true`. Commit: gh:chen/kv-coalesce@b2f3
Anya: Nice work. Next steps: A/B deploy coalesce + kernel-hint on 5% canary, monitor p95, p99, kv_page_evictions, and token/sec. Also run a grid of `num_key_value_heads` (8,16,32,48) for Mistral and Mixtral to quantify tradeoffs
Mike: I'll add a quick canary plan. Action items: @Chen open PR, @Sophia run canary bench, @Anya create dashboard (metrics: p95_latency, kv_page_evictions, avg_batch_tokens, token_per_second). :thumbsup:
Anya: Also add a RoPE scaling check — Mixtral RoPE padding might change cache reuse patterns for concatenated long contexts. Add `long-concat` prompt set to the eval harness
Chen: On it — opening PR and adding bench jobs for the head-grid. I'll include a small script to toggle `num_key_value_heads` and capture mem/throughput: `scripts/kv_head_sweep.sh --model mixtral --seq 512 --batches 100`
Sophia: After canary, if coalesce reduces p99 regressions and cost impact is acceptable, let's merge and follow with a targeted kernel hint to avoid hitting the misaligned codepath. We should also add kernel-selection unit that considers head_stride and kv_slot_size
Anya: Agreed. Logging these in the incident board and tagging runtime-owner. Will follow up with rollout timeline and SLA checks. Thanks, team! :raised_hands:
